title: FileTraceViz log entry (schema_version 1)
description: One line of a session-<id>.jsonl file. Every entry shares the base fields; the shape of the rest depends on `event`. Written by the editor hooks (Phase 1), consumed by the log parser (Phase 2).

ts.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp written by the hook

session_id.description: Claude Code session_id or Cursor conversation_id, verbatim

turn_id.description: 1-based turn counter; incremented by the prompt hook on every user prompt

oneOf.title: read
oneOf.description: The agent read a file. file_path is raw as the editor reported it (no normalization in hooks — the Phase 2 mapper owns path matching).

agent_id.description: null = main agent; set when a subagent read the file (Claude Code only)

generation_id.description: Cursor's raw generation id, kept verbatim for debugging

oneOf.title: user_prompt
oneOf.description: The user submitted a prompt. text is stored FULL LENGTH by an explicit decision (plans/README.md) — log files must never be committed to git.

oneOf.title: agent_response
oneOf.description: The agent's final text for the turn, extracted from the transcript by the Stop hook. May be absent for a turn (user interrupt, Cursor limitation) — consumers must tolerate that.
